highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148.
highlights_body: It rolls up the v4 preview features, including variable fonts and animated WebP encoding, and adds lifecycle and pixel-access fixes. This release contains source and behavioral breaking changes; review the migration guidance before upgrading from v3.

breaking.title: Legacy SKPaint text and font members are compile errors
breaking.body: The legacy paint text and font state members deprecated in v3 are now errors, and the remaining pre-v4 obsolete members are trimmed from the reference assembly. Move typeface, text size, hinting, and text encoding to `SKFont` and use the `SKCanvas.DrawText` overloads that accept it.

breaking.title: Vulkan YCbCr conversion info has a new type name
breaking.body: `GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo` now uses `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo` instead of `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo`. Update references and equality comparisons, because the former type's value-equality interface and operators are removed.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject disposal configuration is read-only
breaking.body: `SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose` no longer has a protected setter. Subclasses that changed it at runtime must set their disposal behavior through their construction path instead.

breaking.title: Default SKFont and SKPaint typeface semantics changed
breaking.body: `new SKFont()` now uses `SKTypeface.Empty`, so text measurement is zero until you supply a typeface; construct it with an explicit face such as `SKTypeface.Default`. `SKPaint.Typeface` now returns a non-null default face, so use `IsEmpty` rather than a null check when detecting an unset face.

breaking.title: Typeface lookup no longer reports a missing family as null
breaking.body: `SKTypeface.FromFamilyName` now falls back to `SKTypeface.Default`, including on Android. Use `SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily` when your application must distinguish an unavailable family and apply its own fallback.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) rejects out-of-range offsets
breaking.body: `Move(long)` is obsolete and now throws `OverflowException` instead of truncating offsets outside the 32-bit native range. Validate or clamp the value and call `Move(int)`.

breaking.title: Ganesh Vulkan now requires Vulkan 1.1
breaking.body: `GRContext.CreateVulkan` can terminate the process rather than return null when the instance is below Vulkan 1.1. Create the instance at Vulkan 1.1 or later and set `GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion` to that version; use another backend for genuinely Vulkan 1.0-only hardware.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative layout changed
breaking.body: Remove assignments to `fMinAPIVersion`, `fInstanceVersion`, `fExtensions`, `fFeatures`, and `fOwnsInstanceAndDevice`. Use `fVkExtensions` and `fDeviceFeatures` or `fDeviceFeatures2` for the replacements, and account for the new `Components` field in YCbCr conversion structs.

bullets.detail: The stable v4 release includes the Skia m148 engine update and upstream m147 bug-fix syncs.
Variable fonts flow through SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, while color font palette selection and variable-font handling are improved.
New surface-draw overloads accept `SKSamplingOptions`, allowing callers to choose filter and mipmap behavior.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP and stream data conversion
bullets.detail: `SKWebpEncoder` can encode frame sequences as animated WebP, and `SKStream.GetData()` converts seekable streams to `SKData` without an intermediate byte array.
HarfBuzzSharp adds the `HBColor` representation and fills in missing wrappers with consistent naming.

bullets.lead: Pixel span access honors bitmap layout
bullets.detail: `GetPixelSpan` honors `RowBytes` for stride, and its coordinate overload calculates the row offset from width, returning correct pixels from non-tight bitmaps.
A collection-order bug no longer crashes finalization when an `SKPathBuilder` is collected before an `SKPath` it created.

bullets.lead: MAUI Android and WinUI startup fixes
bullets.detail: SKGLView is restored after MAUI TabBar switching, and .NET 9 WinUI consumers receive the Projection assembly needed at startup.
Process-wide singleton initialization, disposal, and finalization are coordinated by the managed layer.

bullets.lead: Native compatibility checks run on first API use
bullets.detail: The compatibility gate now runs from the SkiaApi type initializer rather than module initialization, improving startup behavior for AOT and trimmed applications.

bullets.lead: Additional Linux and Tizen native assets
bullets.detail: Android-hosted Linux Bionic and Tizen x64 and arm64 are available as native targets.
Apple libraries align with current versioned TFMs, and WASM native assets now require .NET 8 or later.
The bundled libexpat, libpng, zlib, FreeType, libjpeg-turbo, and HarfBuzz dependencies have been updated.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Skia milestone and variable-font work, managed default-typeface resolution, the SKPath finalizer fix, singleton lifecycle work, and legacy paint API migration
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets and C# 13 support for legacy target frameworks
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: The Android MAUI TabBar fix for SKGLView rendering

preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line with the Skia m147 engine update, variable fonts, surface sampling options, and expanded Linux and Tizen support.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added animated WebP encoding, zero-copy `SKStream.GetData()`, and the SKPath finalizer fix.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added HBColor and HarfBuzz wrapper improvements, refreshed bundled dependencies, and updated WASM targeting.
preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: The release candidate added Skia m148, singleton lifecycle work, pixel-span fixes, and the WinUI .NET 9 startup fix.

harfbuzz_summary: Bundles HarfBuzz 14.2.0 and carries the variable-font, color-palette, HBColor, and wrapper improvements from the v4 line.

v4.148.0-rc.1.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 Release Candidate 1 prepares the first stable v4 release on Skia m148.
v4.148.0-rc.1.2.body: It includes singleton lifecycle work, pixel-span fixes, and the WinUI .NET 9 startup fix.

v4.148.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release.
v4.148.0.body: It finalizes the v4 API migration by promoting the remaining legacy members to errors.
